answer: Each identity claims one beacon relay post in a haven meadow yard, locking a 70-credit bond on its serial. Each epoch it forwards a beacon pulse and files hop times; an auditor recomputes expected hop latency from the public meadow relay-distance table, and a deviation over 3%, a reused serial, or one post serving two burns the bond. First filing 39 credits, the kth 39+6(k-1), the 1000th 6033; 1000 fakes pay 3,036,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-relay ring fails: one rented serial yields duplicate hop times. An honest operator pays 39 once and gets the bond back after a clean epoch.
